title: Pronoms COD / COI / y / en
summary: COD: le/la/les. COI: lui/leur. Place pronouns before the conjugated verb. y = there/to it; en = some/of it/from there.
full_explanation: COD: le/la/les. COI: lui/leur. Place pronouns before the conjugated verb. y = there/to it; en = some/of it/from there. Learn meanings before drilling forms. Say each example aloud. Contrast English word order with French when helpful. Reuse the same lemmas in reading, dialogue, and exercises. Avoid story-memory quizzes — test forms and meanings only. When unsure, reopen the Words to learn first list in the lesson brief. Register matters: vous with strangers, tu with friends who offered it. Silent letters and liaison appear often; listen and repeat. Spiral earlier tools into new sentences. Short daily review beats one long cram session.
